broader_sample.selection_rule: blind continuation of the dev5 rule: order all 120 declared dev qids by SHA256(qid+'20261010') ascending, take ranks 6-25 (dev5 = ranks 1-5); selection blind to scores/gold/judge

broader_sample.baselines: scores/locomo_plus_base_full.json per-question (base variant, 2026-10-08/09 era); v3 never ran these questions (full v3 launch never started)
